about: Patrick M. Noe, Jr., Attorney at Law works from John James Audubon Parkway in Amherst across family law, criminal defence and real estate, and his own firm overview says a client works directly with him from start to finish.

17 reviews at 4.2. He explains six stages of a matrimonial case and describes an uncontested route. His site scores 80 out of 100 and fails Core Web Vitals on blocking time alone, at 768 milliseconds against a 200 millisecond threshold, with a largest contentful paint of 1.7 seconds that is among the fastest here. He publishes no fee.
